source.attribution: Ashtadhyayi and related texts from Vidyut (ambuda.org), data originally shared by ashtadhyayi.com.

method.unit: Whitespace-separated SLP1 surface token from each sutra.
method.ordering: Descending token occurrences, then SLP1 lexical order.
method.normalization: None beyond the source encoding; token spellings are preserved.
limitations: A surface token is not necessarily a standalone dictionary headword.
Sandhi, compounds, inflection, and technical markers are not split or analyzed.
No meanings, translations, commentary, or grammatical labels are inferred.
